verdict.rationale: Vanta's own docs explicitly support building private integrations for on-premise or homegrown systems it does not already integrate with (vanta-docs-52). A developer guide covers pushing user accounts and custom resources from a homegrown app and turning them into pass/fail evidence via a Custom Test (vanta-docs-2). The API is also documented for automating evidence collection and testing across system categories (vanta-docs-32) and for attaching evidence files (vanta-docs-31), with skill files to help build well-formed integrations (vanta-docs-27). Missing for 10: endpoint-level reference pages for the custom-resource push/integration API in the pack, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
